intro.title: Understanding Celebrity Cruise Fares
intro.lead: Understanding what is included on a Celebrity Cruise is important before comparing fares. Celebrity Cruises offers both Cruise-Only and All Included pricing, and the difference can significantly affect the total cost of a vacation.
paragraphs: A standard Celebrity cruise fare covers your stateroom, main dining, entertainment, pools, fitness facilities, and many onboard activities. Depending on the fare selected, drinks, Wi-Fi, and gratuities may also be bundled into the price. Celebrity's current All Included option packages a Classic Drinks Package and Basic Wi-Fi with eligible bookings, while The Retreat includes enhanced beverage and Wi-Fi benefits.
The key is to distinguish between what every cruise fare includes, what All Included adds, and what remains an additional expense.

coreFareInclusions.eyebrow: WHAT DOES A CELEBRITY CRUISE FARE INCLUDE?
coreFareInclusions.title: The Core Cruise Experience, Without Automatically Bundling Drinks and Wi-Fi
coreFareInclusions.description: Celebrity's Cruise-Only fare is designed to cover the core cruise experience without automatically bundling drinks and Wi-Fi. Celebrity states that Cruise-Only rates include accommodation, dining, entertainment, onboard activities, and many other amenities, while drinks, Wi-Fi, and gratuities can be purchased separately.
coreFareInclusions.footerNote: The exact venues, activities, and amenities depend on the ship and itinerary.
items: Access to public areas and lounges

glanceTable.title: Celebrity Cruise Inclusions at a Glance
glanceTable.footnote: Celebrity's current All Included terms should be checked for the specific sailing because packages, eligibility, prices, and promotional conditions can change.

included.eyebrow: IS FOOD INCLUDED ON CELEBRITY CRUISES?
included.title: Yes, Meals Are Included in the Standard Fare
included.lead: Celebrity states that breakfast, lunch, dinner, and late-night snacks are part of the core cruise experience. Standard dining venues vary by ship but provide excellent options.
options: Room-service items where included under the applicable service terms
included.footnote: The specific complimentary restaurants available depend on your ship.

specialty.title: Usually, No
specialty.lead: Celebrity offers specialty restaurants in addition to its included dining venues. These restaurants generally require an additional charge or dining package. Specialty dining can include premium restaurants focused on:
specialty.footnote: If dining is an important part of your cruise, check the restaurant lineup for your particular ship before booking.

drinks.title: What Drinks Are Included?
drinks.subtitle: Celebrity's drink inclusion depends on your fare type. Here's what each option offers.

options.title: Cruise-Only Fare
options.description: With a Cruise-Only fare, drinks are generally purchased separately. You can buy beverage packages onboard or pay per drink.

options.title: All Included Fare
options.description: Celebrity's All Included package bundles a Classic Drinks Package with eligible bookings, covering a selection of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages.

options.title: Premium Upgrade
options.description: Celebrity also offers a Premium Drinks Package for travelers who want a broader selection of wines, spirits, and cocktails.

drinks.note: The Classic package covers wines by the glass up to the specified package limit, while Premium extends the selection and price range.

overview.eyebrow: IS WI-FI INCLUDED ON CELEBRITY CRUISES?
overview.title: Basic Wi-Fi Is Included With Eligible All Included Fares
overview.lead: Celebrity describes Basic Wi-Fi as suitable for web browsing, email, and text messaging. It does not provide the same streaming and video-call capabilities as Premium Wi-Fi.
overview.body: With Cruise-Only pricing, Wi-Fi is generally available for an additional charge.
overview.footnote: Travelers who need streaming, video calls, or more demanding internet access should compare the cost of upgrading to Premium Wi-Fi.

comparison.title: What Is the Difference Between Basic and Premium Wi-Fi?
comparison.footnote: Celebrity currently describes Premium Wi-Fi as supporting video chat, social media, browsing, email, and streaming video and music.

gratuities.eyebrow: ARE GRATUITIES INCLUDED ON CELEBRITY CRUISES?
gratuities.title: This Depends on the Fare and Booking Terms
gratuities.description: Celebrity's current All Included package includes tips as part of the package for eligible bookings, while Cruise-Only rates can have gratuities charged separately. Celebrity's current terms distinguish beverage-package gratuities from other onboard gratuities, so travelers should review the exact fare conditions. This is one reason comparing the total fare is more useful than comparing the headline cruise price.

entertainment.title: Are Entertainment and Shows Included?
entertainment.description: Yes. A wide range of onboard entertainment is included in the cruise fare. From Broadway-style theater performances to intimate live music sets, Celebrity Cruises provides diverse daily programming to suit all preferences.
entertainment.footnote: Entertainment varies by ship and sailing, so the onboard program should be checked once the itinerary is confirmed.

pools.title: Are Pools Included?
pools.body: Yes. Access to the ship's standard pools and outdoor deck spaces is included in the fare. Depending on the vessel, Celebrity features:
pools.note: Note: Specialized Solarium spaces are adults-only.

fitness.title: Is the Fitness Center Included?
fitness.body: Access to standard cardio, strength-training equipment, and designated workout zones is fully included. Facilities feature:
fitness.note: Note: Personal training or specialized classes carry a fee.

kids.title: Are Kids' Activities Included?
kids.body: Celebrity provides included youth programming at Camp at Sea. Age-appropriate spaces and scheduled programs include:
kids.note: Note: Late-night care or baby services may be extra.

shoreExcursions.title: Generally, No
shoreExcursions.lead: Shore excursions are normally an additional expense. Celebrity offers destination experiences that can include:
shoreExcursions.footnote: Travelers can choose whether to purchase organized excursions or explore ports independently.

coffee.title: Is Specialty Coffee Included?
coffee.text: It depends on the beverage package and the specific drink. Some specialty coffee and tea options are covered by the Classic Drinks Package, while premium selections may fall under different package rules. Celebrity's package terms should be checked before assuming a particular beverage is included.

roomService.title: Is Room Service Included?
roomService.text: Room-service availability and charges can vary by item and service. Do not assume that everything delivered to your cabin is included simply because meals are included in the cruise fare. Before ordering, check menu price, delivery or service charges, beverage-package eligibility, and special dining promotions.

miniBar.title: Is the Mini-Bar Included?
miniBar.text: Mini-bar items are generally not covered by the standard beverage package. Celebrity specifically excludes mini-bar items and certain in-stateroom purchases from its Classic and Premium Drinks Package.

retreat.title: A Suite-Level Experience, Not a Standard Inclusion
retreat.lead: The Retreat is Celebrity's suite-level experience rather than a standard inclusion. Guests booked in The Retreat receive enhanced benefits, including a Premium Drinks Package, Premium Wi-Fi, and additional suite-level benefits under the applicable terms.
retreat.body: Specialty restaurants generally remain an additional cost even under The Retreat. Always verify the benefits listed for your exact suite because facilities differ between vessels.

notIncluded.title: What's Not Included on a Celebrity Cruise?
notIncluded.subtitle: Even when many parts of the cruise are included, you should budget separately for certain expenses.
items: Hotels before or after the cruise
notIncluded.note: The exact charges depend on the sailing and services purchased.

cruiseOnlyVsAllIncluded.title: Celebrity Cruise-Only vs. All Included
cruiseOnlyVsAllIncluded.intro: The biggest fare decision is often whether to select Cruise-Only or All Included. Celebrity says All Included bundles Classic Drinks and Basic Wi-Fi for eligible bookings, with the current package also including applicable tips.
cruiseOnlyVsAllIncluded.badge: Compare actual Cruise-Only and All Included prices for the same sailing before deciding.
cruiseOnlyReasons: You want the lowest upfront cruise fare.
You plan to spend most of your time ashore.
You prefer paying only for services you actually use.
allIncludedReasons: You want Wi-Fi throughout the cruise.
You would otherwise purchase beverage and internet packages.
You want applicable tips bundled into the fare.

cost.title: How Much Does All Included Cost?
cost.body: There is no single price for All Included because pricing depends on factors such as:
cost.note: Compare the actual Cruise-Only and All Included prices for the same sailing before booking.

afterBooking.title: Can You Add It After Booking?
afterBooking.body: Celebrity's current info says the package is selected at booking and is not generally available to add afterward in the same way as a normal package.
afterBooking.note: Existing guests should check their Cruise Planner or contact Celebrity for options applicable to their booking.

samePackage.title: Same Package for All Guests?
samePackage.body: For eligible All Included bookings, Celebrity states that all guests in the same stateroom must choose the same pricing package.
samePackage.note: This is particularly important for couples or families where one traveler drinks alcohol and another does not.

budgetPhases.title: What Should You Budget for Separately?
budgetPhases.intro: A realistic Celebrity cruise budget should account for more than just the base cruise fare. Divide your extra expenses into three distinct phases to ensure no surprises.

bestValueSteps.title: How to Get the Best Value From Celebrity Cruise Inclusions
bestValueSteps.intro: Get the most out of your fare inclusions by planning ahead. Follow these steps to optimize your options before you book.

steps.title: Compare the Same Sailing
steps.desc: Never compare a Cruise-Only fare on one sailing with an All Included fare on another and assume one is cheaper. Use the same ship, sailing date, cabin category, occupancy, and cruise length, then compare the total price.

steps.title: Calculate Your Beverage Usage
steps.desc: If you drink very little, paying extra for a beverage package may not provide much value. If you regularly purchase cocktails, wine, specialty coffee, bottled water, and soft drinks, an included package may be more attractive.

steps.title: Consider Your Wi-Fi Needs
steps.desc: If you only need occasional email and messaging, Basic Wi-Fi may be enough. If you need video calls, streaming, work applications, or frequent social media uploads, Premium Wi-Fi may be more appropriate.

steps.title: Check What Your Cabin Already Includes
steps.desc: AquaClass and The Retreat can have additional benefits, so do not purchase separate packages without checking what is already included in your fare.

isItAllInclusive.eyebrow: IS A CELEBRITY CRUISE ALL INCLUSIVE?
isItAllInclusive.title: Not Fully All Inclusive in the Traditional Sense
isItAllInclusive.lead: Celebrity Cruises should not automatically be considered fully all-inclusive in the traditional luxury-resort sense. Celebrity offers All Included pricing, but the package covers specific benefits rather than every possible onboard or vacation expense.
isItAllInclusive.description: For example, specialty dining, shore excursions, spa treatments, shopping, flights, and other optional purchases can still cost extra. The phrase All Included therefore means a bundled Celebrity fare with specified amenities, not that every expense during the trip is covered.
isItAllInclusive.quote: Compare the complete cost of the same sailing under each fare option before deciding which one fits your travel style.

keyTakeaways.title: Key Takeaways
keyTakeaways.subtitle: Review the most essential facts regarding Celebrity Cruise fare inclusions to help plan your cruise budget effectively.
items: Celebrity Cruise fares include the core cruise experience, including accommodation, dining, entertainment, pools, fitness facilities, and many onboard activities.
Cruise-Only fares generally do not include the same drinks, Wi-Fi, and gratuity benefits as All Included.
All Included currently bundles a Classic Drinks Package and Basic Wi-Fi for eligible bookings, with applicable tips included under Celebrity's current terms.
The Retreat provides enhanced suite-level benefits, including Premium Drinks and Premium Wi-Fi under the applicable All Included structure.
Specialty dining, shore excursions, spa treatments, shopping, and many other optional services can cost extra.
Basic Wi-Fi is designed for browsing, email, and messaging, while Premium Wi-Fi adds more demanding capabilities such as streaming and video calls.
Comparing Cruise-Only and All Included pricing for the exact same sailing is the best way to determine which fare offers better value.

questions.question: What is included on a Celebrity Cruise?
questions.answer: Celebrity Cruise fares generally include your stateroom, main dining, selected casual dining, entertainment, pools, fitness facilities, and many onboard activities. Drinks, Wi-Fi, and gratuities depend on the fare selected.

questions.question: Are meals included on Celebrity Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Breakfast, lunch, dinner, and many snacks are included, along with dining at selected complimentary venues. Specialty restaurants generally cost extra.

questions.question: Are drinks included on Celebrity Cruises?
questions.answer: Drinks depend on the fare. Cruise-Only fares generally charge separately for beverages, while eligible All Included bookings include the Classic Drinks Package.

questions.question: Does Celebrity All Included include alcohol?
questions.answer: Yes. The Classic Drinks Package included with eligible All Included bookings covers a selection of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages subject to package rules and limits.

questions.question: Is Wi-Fi included on Celebrity Cruises?
questions.answer: Basic Wi-Fi is included with eligible All Included fares. Cruise-Only guests can purchase Wi-Fi separately, while Premium Wi-Fi provides additional capabilities such as streaming and video calls.

questions.question: Are gratuities included on Celebrity Cruises?
questions.answer: Gratuities depend on the fare. Celebrity's current All Included terms include applicable tips, while Cruise-Only fares can charge gratuities separately.

questions.question: Is specialty dining included on Celebrity Cruises?
questions.answer: Generally, no. Specialty restaurants usually require an additional charge or dining package, while the main dining and selected casual venues are included.

questions.question: Are shore excursions included on Celebrity Cruises?
questions.answer: No. Shore excursions are generally purchased separately. Prices vary depending on the destination, activity, duration, and excursion type.

questions.question: Is room service included on Celebrity Cruises?
questions.answer: Room-service availability and charges vary by item and service. Travelers should check the current onboard menu and applicable charges before ordering.

questions.question: Are pools and fitness centers included on Celebrity Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Standard pool access and fitness-center access are generally included in the cruise fare. Certain specialized fitness services or treatments may cost extra.

questions.question: Are entertainment and shows included on Celebrity Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Many theater shows, live performances, activities, and entertainment programs are included in the cruise fare, although offerings vary by ship and sailing.

questions.question: What is included in Celebrity The Retreat?
questions.answer: The Retreat is Celebrity's suite-level experience. Current benefits can include suite accommodations, Premium Drinks, Premium Wi-Fi, enhanced service, and access to suite-focused amenities, with exact benefits varying by ship and fare.

questions.question: Is Celebrity Cruises fully all inclusive?
questions.answer: No. Celebrity's All Included pricing bundles specified benefits such as drinks, Wi-Fi, and applicable tips, but optional expenses including specialty dining, excursions, spa treatments, shopping, and some other services can remain extra.

questions.question: Is Celebrity All Included worth it?
questions.answer: It depends on how much you expect to use the included drinks and Wi-Fi and whether you value having applicable tips bundled into the fare. Compare the Cruise-Only and All Included prices for the same sailing before deciding.

questions.question: Can I add All Included after booking a Celebrity cruise?
questions.answer: Celebrity's current information says All Included is selected at booking and is not generally available to add afterward as the same fare option. Existing guests should check their booking or contact Celebrity for options specific to their reservation.

conclusion.title: Booking Advice
conclusion.quote: A Celebrity Cruise delivers an exceptional premium resort experience, but booking smart means choosing the fare package that fits your lifestyle.
conclusion.heading: Compare the Complete Cost Before You Book
